headline: 国庆档影剧热力全开：新片新剧齐发
summary: 本周影市由《什么意思夫妇》《神探之痕迹》等领跑；新剧《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》首播，《菜鸟老警》《龙族》等热播剧持续吸睛；《复仇者联盟5》《仙逆剧场版》等待映片蓄势。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《什么意思夫妇》《神探之痕迹》领跑，本周市场类型多元。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: What Do You Mean, Couple? and Trace of the Detective lead a diverse week.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》开播，剧集竞争升温。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Witch Academy and Equipment Master debut, heating up series competition.

industryHighlights.text: 热播续航：《菜鸟老警》《龙族》《瑞克和莫蒂》《梦魇绝镇》《黑色丽人》保持热度。
industryHighlights.en: Hit series: The Rookie, House of the Dragon, Rick and Morty, From and Black Beauty stay hot.

industryHighlights.text: 待映蓄势：《复仇者联盟5》《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《猫鼬》《泥面人》等受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Avengers 5, Xian Ni The Movie: Battle to Kill Immortals, Mongoose and Clayface draw attention.

headlineEn: National Day screen heats up: new films and series launch
summaryEn: This week’s movie buzz is led by What Do You Mean, Couple? and Trace of the Detective; new series Witch Academy and Equipment Master premiere, while hit shows The Rookie and House of the Dragon stay in focus; upcoming films include Avengers 5 and Xian Ni The Movie.
